command:
set -eu; test -x $HOME/.local/bin/frank-terminal-hilfe; tmp=$(mktemp $HOME/.local/bin/.frank.XXXXXX); cat > "$tmp" <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
exec "$HOME/.local/bin/frank-terminal-hilfe" "$@"
EOF
chmod 755 "$tmp"; mv "$tmp" $HOME/.local/bin/frank; echo FRANK=$(command -v frank); sha256sum $HOME/.local/bin/frank; head -5 $HOME/.local/bin/frank
